confirmation.quantile: For each comparison use the ceil(B * family_alpha / comparisons)-th smallest shared-pair bootstrap mean as a one-sided lower bound; require strict greater-than threshold. These are nominal approximate Bonferroni bounds, not finite-sample guarantees.

metrics: tactical minus baseline score against random
tactical minus baseline score against damage
pairing: Same two admitted teams in fixed seats and same mechanics seed for each pair across edges; swap policy seats. Policy streams keyed by policy and pair. Resample whole pairs using common indices across all metrics.
freshness: Require zero exact-team overlap with the sealed opponent panel, its smoke pool, and this milestone smoke/network pools; fresh namespace and unchanged policy definitions. Do not replace a colliding pair: fail admission.
stopping: Complete all 12000 games and all fresh replays. No optional stopping, tuning, difficult-pair replacement or scoring failures as losses.
decision: Pass only if every lower-bound comparison passes and direct point score is at least 0.52. Failure is an honest non-promotion result; never relax thresholds or extend this run. Network qualification is a separate local functional test and does not override this screen.
